defs.def: confident, sometimes aggressive behaviour that shows you do not care about other people's opinions and that you want to do things in an individual way 我行我素的做派

ex.s: It’s an attitude best summed up as “Move fast and break things.”
ex.t: 这种态度可概括为“快速行动，打破陈规”。

ex.s: We've all known people who run out of steam before they reach life's halfway mark． I'm not talking about those who fail to get to the top． We can't all get there． I'm talking about people who have stopped learning on growing because they have adopted the fixed attitudes and opinions that all too often come with passing years．
ex.t: 我们都认识那些在人生过半前就耗尽动力的人。我不是说那些没能爬到顶的人。我们不可能都到顶。我说的是那些停止学习和成长的人，因为他们采取了伴随着岁月而来的、太过常见的固定态度和看法。

ex.s: A good attitude can have a positive effect on other people.
ex.t: 作为回报，这可能促使我们给出真实的回答。
